name: Transformer Forge
text: Status: In progress. A tiny forward block with tested rotary positions, SwiGLU and grouped-query attention. Implemented: Adjacent-pair RoPE with correct dimension-dependent frequencies; Causal grouped-query attention with shared KV heads; Pre-norm residual block and SwiGLU feedforward; Numerical identity, grouping and causal-prefix tests. Next: Add checkpoint loading, tokenization and a full model stack; Implement backward passes and a training experiment; Compare against a trusted framework and profile kernels. Limits: Toy dimensions and deterministic synthetic weights; CPU forward only. No trained model, KV cache, GPU kernels or full training runtime.

name: ProcessLens PRM
text: Status: In progress. A deterministic arithmetic step validator that establishes the data and feedback boundary for future process supervision. Implemented: Exact bounded rational-expression parser; Step verdicts with expected values and feedback; Commit-only-on-success dependency tracking; Tests for incorrect steps, invalid syntax and arithmetic bounds. Next: Define labeled reasoning-trajectory schema and dataset loader; Train and calibrate a learned step-scoring model; Evaluate general reasoning and held-out trajectory selection. Limits: Deterministic validator only; not a trained process reward model. Supports structured arithmetic expressions, not natural-language reasoning or general proofs.

name: GroupAlign GRPO
text: Status: In progress. Group-relative reward normalization and a clipped policy objective, verified on hand-calculated fixtures. Implemented: Group-relative advantages with a zero-variance safeguard; Sign-correct clipped importance-ratio surrogate; Sampled reference-policy KL penalty; Equal completion weighting with token means and numerical tests. Next: Connect rollout generation and policy log probabilities; Add autodiff, optimizer updates and reference-model lifecycle; Run controlled alignment and reward-quality evaluations. Limits: Objective evaluator only. No neural network, policy updates, rollout service, training dataset or completed alignment pipeline.

name: SpecServe
text: Status: In progress. The exact speculative-sampling rejection and correction rule on toy distributions, with context-dependent distribution checks. Implemented: Autoregressive draft proposals with target acceptance ratios; Positive target-minus-draft correction distribution; Bonus target token after an accepted draft block; Analytic mass identity and seeded context-dependent sampling tests. Next: Integrate real draft and target model adapters; Batch target verification and handle KV-cache rollback; Measure end-to-end latency and distribution fidelity on real models. Limits: Toy probability callbacks and sequential target evaluation; no real model serving, batching, streaming or measured speedup.

name: VectorGate Cache
text: Status: In progress. A bounded in-process cosine cache that requires exact metadata isolation before similarity lookup. Implemented: Normalized cosine lookup and exact request hits; Exact tenant, authorization and model-context namespace isolation; Entry-count capacity, LRU eviction, expiry and key replacement; Tested cache core plus a documented proxy adapter boundary. Next: Build an authenticated provider-compatible network adapter; Add concurrency, byte quotas, invalidation and telemetry; Calibrate semantic hit quality on domain-specific held-out requests. Limits: Single-threaded in-memory cache; not a deployed network proxy. Similarity is not proof of equivalence, and capacity bounds entry count rather than total bytes.
